entities.name: Monarchs of Amonkhet
entities.description: Undead kings, queens and emperors from before and early in Bolas's reign who rule the restless dead in the Broken Lands.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The plane where the Monarchs lie.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: The city flourishing by the Luxa that the Monarchs hope to rule again.

entities.name: Broken Lands
entities.description: Desert region where the Monarchs' tombs lie.

entities.name: Chitin Court
entities.description: The gods of Amonkhet before Bolas's reign, to whom nearly all Monarchs swear loyalty.

entities.name: Tombs Before Time
entities.description: Vast region of the Broken Lands where unsatisfied dead monarchs gather.

events.summary: The Monarchs war among themselves across the Broken Lands to decide who is de facto ruler of Amonkhet.
events.quote: These competing monarchs war between themselves across the Broken Lands

events.summary: After the plane's defense, unsatisfied monarchs retreat to their tombs and plot their return around the Tombs Before Time.

relations.quote: nearly all of them swear loyalty to the Chitin Court
